title: Hold a radiation management licence
what: Hold a radiation management licence before owning, storing, selling or possessing radiation apparatus, sealed radioactive sources or other regulated material.

sources.title: Protection from Harmful Radiation Act 1990 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person responsible for regulated material must hold a radiation management licence in respect of the regulated material and must comply with any conditions to which the licence is subject.

sources.title: Protection from Harmful Radiation Act 1990 (NSW)
